title: 统计没有收到请求的服务器数目
summary: 给定服务器请求日志，对每个查询统计时间区间 [query-x,query] 内没有收到请求的服务器数。
insight: 把日志按时间、查询按时间分别排序，用双指针维护当前查询窗口中的日志。服务器计数从零变一或从一变零时同步维护活跃服务器数，答案就是 n 减活跃数。
pitfalls: 查询窗口左右端点都包含
多个查询要按原顺序返回
同一服务器在窗口内可能有多条日志

solutions.title: 离线查询加日志滑动窗口
solutions.idea: 查询时间单调增加时复用窗口内服务器频次。
steps: 查询下标按 queries 值升序
加入所有 time<=query 的日志
移除所有 time<query-x 的日志

code.java: class Solution { public int[] countServers(int n,int[][] logs,int x,int[] queries){Arrays.sort(logs,(a,b)->Integer.compare(a[1],b[1]));Integer[] order=new Integer[queries.length];for(int i=0;i<order.length;i++)order[i]=i;Arrays.sort(order,(a,b)->Integer.compare(queries[a],queries[b]));int[] frequency=new int[n+1],answer=new int[queries.length];int left=0,right=0,active=0;for(int queryIndex:order){int query=queries[queryIndex];while(right<logs.length&&logs[right][1]<=query){int server=logs[right++][0];if(frequency[server]++==0)active++;}while(left<right&&logs[left][1]<query-x){int server=logs[left++][0];if(--frequency[server]==0)active--;}answer[queryIndex]=n-active;}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun countServers(n:Int,logs:Array<IntArray>,x:Int,queries:IntArray):IntArray{logs.sortWith(Comparator{a,b->a[1].compareTo(b[1])});val order=Array(queries.size){it};order.sortWith(Comparator{a,b->queries[a].compareTo(queries[b])});val frequency=IntArray(n+1);val answer=IntArray(queries.size);var left=0;var right=0;var active=0;for(queryIndex in order){val query=queries[queryIndex];while(right<logs.size&&logs[right][1]<=query){val server=logs[right++][0];if(frequency[server]++==0)active++};while(left<right&&logs[left][1]<query-x){val server=logs[left++][0];frequency[server]--;if(frequency[server]==0)active--};answer[queryIndex]=n-active};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:vector<int> countServers(int n,vector<vector<int>>& logs,int x,vector<int>& queries){sort(logs.begin(),logs.end(),[](auto& a,auto& b){return a[1]<b[1];});vector<int> order(queries.size()),frequency(n+1),answer(queries.size());iota(order.begin(),order.end(),0);sort(order.begin(),order.end(),[&](int a,int b){return queries[a]<queries[b];});int left=0,right=0,active=0;for(int queryIndex:order){int query=queries[queryIndex];while(right<(int)logs.size()&&logs[right][1]<=query){int server=logs[right++][0];if(frequency[server]++==0)++active;}while(left<right&&logs[left][1]<query-x){int server=logs[left++][0];if(--frequency[server]==0)--active;}answer[queryIndex]=n-active;}return answer;} };
